messages:
morgan: Quick sweep — SDK/docs release tomorrow 09:00 PT. Quickstarts + sample-apps need final OK. Any blockers?

sasha: Quickstarts: all updated except react-sample. I hit an import error from new @redwood/embeddings v2.2. Need a patch. @anish can you look?

anish: On it. I can cut a tiny patch. ETA 2h. Will open PR and tag @sasha and @morgan.

leo: Docs: versioned quickstart pages staged. Need CLI note about `rw auth` flag change. I'm holding merge until changelog freeze sign-off.

morgan: Changelog cutoff is today 17:00 PT. If your PRs need entry after that we should mention in release notes as post-launch.

tara: Sample-app infra: CI flakes on e2e because test user creation times out. Root cause seems unrelated to SDK, but it blocks smoke runs. Rolling a retry in CI for now. @samir can you watch?

samir: ✅ watching. Will try to stabilize the fixture tonight. If not, we can quarantine the failing test from the smoke suite before RC.

devex-bot: deploy scheduled: docs-preview -> staging at 06:30 PT. (link: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai)

morgan: Action items:
- @anish: PR for embeddings patch (ETA 2h)
- @leo: add CLI note + hold merge until changelog sign-off
- @tara/@samir: stabilize e2e or quarantine test
- @sasha: once patch merged, run quickstarts smoke

Also adding a tiny code snippet we want in the changelog under 'breaking changes':
```
# package.json"peerDependencies": {
  "@redwood/embeddings": ">=2.2.1"
}
```

sasha: After @anish PR merges I'll run through 3 sample apps and push updates. If anyone needs manual verification ping me.

leo: FYI I'm updating the release notes with a 'known issues' section referencing the e2e flake. Will link to this thread.

morgan: Great. If no blockers after the patch, we proceed with freeze at 17:00 PT and deploy. Thanks all :rocket:

sasha: :thumbsup:

anish: PR opened: #842 — fixes import path. @morgan @sasha please review.

morgan: Reviewing now.
